text:
maria: :rotating_light: FYI CS just escalated AcmeRetail 5xxs on their dedicated pool. Theyre hitting p99 SLA risk during peak. Need quick owner alignment and an immediate workaround timeline. Ticket: #INC-2287. Can eng-platform + runtime folks pick this up?

alex: on it. I can own platform-side coordination. @drew can you confirm if this looks like routing or kernel issues?

drew: looks like routing hotspots to pool-3 replicas, KV cache pressure. Seeing lots of retries: `503` with `x-retry-count: 2`. I can propose a routing weight change as a mitigation.

kai: I can apply a routing weight tweak now (no deploy) to shift new requests off pool-3 for short window. Need approval from product/CS for temporary degradation of locality.

maria: CS gave verbal ok for 30m routing diversion as long as latency doesn't jump > 50ms. Proceed and post metrics.

alex: @kai go ahead. After that we should schedule a hotpatch to fix rate-limiter config and increase prefix cache size. Proposed timeline: immediate weight change (0-15m), hotpatch build + test (60-90m), deploy (2h).

infra-bot: Deploy queue length: 3. Estimated start for hotpatch pipeline: 57 minutes.

drew: hotpatch diff (sketch):
```
- rate_limiter.max_burst = 500
+ rate_limiter.max_burst = 1200
- kv_cache.max_entries = 200_000
+ kv_cache.max_entries = 350_000
```
I also recommend a conservative canary (5% traffic) for 20m before full rollout.

jamie: Ill own the canary monitoring dashboard and alert thresholds. Will post graphs once weight change is applied.

kai: weight change applied to route -> pool-3 weight: 0.15 (was 0.65). Monitoring now.

maria: thanks. CS asked for owner contact to tell customer. Alex, can you be the primary update contact?

alex: yes, Ill update CS and the account team. Will post a summary after 15m check.

drew: quick note: if errors persist after weight change, we escalate to rollback model-variant routing and open a blocker for runtime patch.

jamie: initial metrics: error rate down 62% on affected shards, p99 latency +12ms. Will keep monitoring.

maria: this is great. Final ask: confirm the hotpatch owner (drew), canary monitor (jamie), customer comms (alex), ops apply (kai). If anyone cant commit ping here now.

alex: confirmed. Ill also attach the incident slack link to the ticket.

kai: will keep watch and escalate if packet loss or latency > +70ms.

drew: starting hotpatch build now. ETA to canary start ~55m.

maria: thanks team. Ill update execs after first-canary results. :thumbsup:

(incident follow-up will be captured in #INC-2287 — thread archived after resolution)
